preBooking.heading: Pre-Booking, made simple
preBooking.intro: Decide calmly today, so your family never has to improvise later. Register now and we will record your wishes and update you as plans go live.

items.title: Decide calmly
items.text: Choose with a clear mind today, not in the hardest hour.

items.title: Your wishes on record
items.text: Tell us once. Nothing is asked of your family twice.

items.title: One less thing for them
items.text: Your family knows who to call, and what you wanted.

items.title: Share a few details
items.text: Two required fields, the rest optional. It takes a minute.

items.title: We call you
items.text: A member of our team calls to understand your wishes, unhurried.

items.title: You are on record
items.text: Your details are noted, and we keep you updated as pre-booking plans go live.
